value.behaviour: Geometry, bounds and hit-testing tests for per-element arrowhead size (AC-2, AC-3, AC-7).
rules: 1. Build arrows with API.createElement({ type: "arrow", points, endArrowhead, arrowheadSize, roughness: 0, strokeWidth: 2 }) and shapes with ShapeCache.generateElementShape(arrow, null), as bounds.test.ts does.

2. The base arrow is a straight 200px horizontal arrow (points (0,0) and (200,0)) with endArrowhead "triangle", so a large head (37.5px back, half-width 37.5*tan 25deg) reaches outside the 0-height shaft bounds; compare against the same arrow without the field.

3. Hit points use hitElementItself({ point, element, threshold: 10, elementsMap }) from ../src/collision; box selection uses elementsOverlappingBBox({ elements, bounds, type: "contain" }) from ../src/bounds.

tests.name: maps presets to scale factors
tests.given: getArrowheadSizeScale for small, medium, large, null, undefined and "huge"
tests.expect: 0.6, 1, 1.5, 1, 1, 1; isArrowheadSize is true only for the three keys

tests.name: scales the base size
tests.given: getArrowheadSize("arrow") and getArrowheadSize("arrow", 1.5)

tests.name: keeps the arrow head's angle proportions at any scale
tests.given: getArrowheadAngle("arrow", full size, scale) for scales 0.6 and 1.5, and at the scaled widest size
tests.expect: 20 degrees at full size and 30 degrees at ARROW_ARROWHEAD_WIDEST_SIZE * scale (10 * scale), for both scales

tests.name: no field and medium give today's head points
tests.given: the base arrow without arrowheadSize, with null and with "medium", for triangle, arrow and cardinality_one_or_many
tests.expect: getArrowheadPoints returns equal arrays in all three cases

tests.name: small and large heads scale the head extent
tests.given: the base arrow with small and with large
tests.expect: the triangle's back corners are 0.6x and 1.5x as far from the tip as without the field

tests.name: a short last segment still clamps a large head
tests.given: an arrow whose last segment is 20px long with arrowheadSize large and an arrow end head
tests.expect: the head's length from the tip is at most the length the clamp allows for a medium head on the same segment times 1.5 and below 37.5

tests.name: large heads widen the element bounds
tests.given: the base arrow with large versus without the field
tests.expect: getElementBounds of the large arrow is strictly larger on the y axis and contains every point of getArrowheadPoints for the end head

tests.name: small, medium and lines keep today's bounds
tests.given: the base arrow with small and with medium, and a line with arrowheadSize large
tests.expect: getElementBounds equals the bounds of the same element without the field

tests.name: hit results are unchanged at small and medium
tests.given: points on the shaft, 5px off it, and on the drawn head, for no field, small and medium
tests.expect: hitElementItself gives the same result for each point as the arrow without the field

tests.name: the precise test stays shaft-only at large
tests.given: the large base arrow, a point on the shaft and a point 60px off the shaft outside the widened bounds
tests.expect: the shaft point hits and the far point misses

tests.name: box selection follows a large head
tests.given: a contain box enclosing the shaft with 5px margin but not the large head's back corners
tests.expect: elementsOverlappingBBox selects the arrow without the field and does not select the large arrow

tests.name: changing the size refreshes cached bounds
tests.given: getElementBounds read once, then newElementWith(arrow, { arrowheadSize: "large" })
tests.expect: the new element's bounds are the large bounds, not the cached medium ones

tests.name: factories write no key without a size
tests.given: newArrowElement and newLinearElement with arrowheadSize undefined, null and "small"
tests.expect: no arrowheadSize key for undefined and null; "small" is kept

style_from.reason: Imports, API.createElement and ShapeCache.generateElementShape scaffolding for geometry tests.

value.behaviour: Editor tests for the arrowhead size control, appState default, creation, paste styles, flip, undo, restore and SVG export (AC-1, AC-4, AC-5).
rules: 1. `beforeEach(async () => { await render(<Excalidraw handleKeyboardGlobally={true} />); })`; elements via API.createElement/API.setElements/API.setSelectedElements; controls by testId with queryByTestId and fireEvent.click.

2. Restore cases call restoreElements from ../data/restore; the export case calls exportScene({ type: "svg", data: { elements, files: null } }) from ../scene/export and measures the end head by the numbers in its path `d` attribute.

tests.name: shows the control for arrows and for lines with a head
tests.given: an arrow selected; a line with endArrowhead "arrow" selected; a line without heads selected; the arrow tool active with nothing selected
tests.expect: arrowheadSize-medium is present, present, absent, present

tests.name: changing the size updates selection and the default
tests.given: two selected arrows and a click on arrowheadSize-large
tests.expect: both arrows have arrowheadSize "large", h.state.currentItemArrowheadSize is "large", and arrowheadSize-large is checked

tests.name: picking medium stores medium
tests.given: a large arrow selected and a click on arrowheadSize-medium
tests.expect: arrowheadSize is "medium"

tests.name: undo restores the previous size
tests.given: an arrow changed from no size to small, then UI.undo() and then a redo
tests.expect: after undo the arrow has no size (undefined); after redo it is "small"

tests.name: new arrows take the current size
tests.given: currentItemArrowheadSize set to "small" and an arrow drawn with UI.createElement("arrow")
tests.expect: the new arrow's arrowheadSize is "small"; with currentItemArrowheadSize null a drawn arrow has no arrowheadSize key

tests.name: paste styles copies the size
tests.given: copy styles from a large arrow, paste onto an arrow without a size
tests.expect: the target's arrowheadSize is "large"

tests.name: flip keeps the size
tests.given: a bound small arrow flipped horizontally
tests.expect: arrowheadSize is still "small"

tests.name: restore keeps valid sizes and drops others
tests.given: restoreElements on arrows with "small", "huge", null and no field
tests.expect: "small" is kept; the other three have no arrowheadSize key, and the no-field arrow equals today's restore output

tests.name: restoreAppState validates the default
tests.given: restoreAppState with currentItemArrowheadSize "large", "huge" and missing
tests.expect: "large", null, null

tests.name: SVG export draws a smaller small head
tests.given: the same 200px arrow exported with arrowheadSize "small" and without the field
tests.expect: the small head's path extent is measurably smaller than the default head's

rules: 1. A `### Arrowhead size (2026-11-06)` heading and bullets: the optional `arrowheadSize` element field (`"small" | "medium" | "large"`, scale 0.6 / 1 / 1.5, absent or null = today's size, both heads); the new `appState.currentItemArrowheadSize` (default null, browser storage only); the properties-panel control for arrows and lines with heads; that large heads widen the element's bounds (selection box, box/lasso selection, export) while hit-testing stays on the shaft; and that the skeleton API accepts `arrowheadSize`.
